changes: WP-12-watchdog_logging: watchdog + unified logging + health monitor. Hardware watchdog: Intel TCO discovery (LPC PMBASE, RCBA enable via PCI config 0xF0, GCS NO_REBOOT at RCBA+0x3410 cleared on arm - the iTCO_wdt update_no_reboot_bit step, found live via -trace tco_timer_expired) plus a full ACPI WDAT parser (24-byte entries, Header Length honoured, SystemIO + SystemMemory GAS with the table's own value/mask), WDAT taking precedence when present; hw start N arms the real countdown and expiry hard-resets the machine (QEMU q35: REAL reset -> second boot; a synthetic 164-byte WDAT via -acpitable drives the same path); the default pc machine reports none honestly. Software watchdog: 16 monitored slots (watchdog_register/start/feed/stop/set_timeout) on a 1 s tick, four policies (PANIC through the full WP-11 path / REBOOT / KILL task-only / LOG once per episode); slot 0 wraps the WP-11 system heartbeat, the health sampler feeds it every second (boot default DISARMED - the documented WP-11 decision). Unified five-level kernel log: DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR/FATAL with independent per-level switches, a 1024-entry ring (64-entry static bootstrap ring keeps the identity-window ASSERT), serial + VGA live channels, the /var/log/kernel.log file channel (task-context appends, IRQ writers set dirty, panic flush for non-#DF sources), flush-first rotation at a runtime threshold (kernel.log -> .1 -> .2 -> .3, keep 3), and a level/module/keyword filter scoping live output AND replay. Health monitor: a 1 s sampler (CPU busy% from scheduler idle/total counters, PMM + heap memory, task states, disk + network counters), rising-edge alarms (mem > 90%, tasks > 64, cpu >= 90% for 10 consecutive samples), JSON export to /var/log/health.json. New commands dmesg / logcat (-l/-m/-k/-t/-n + -f) / logctl / watchdog / health / health watch / health export (226 -> 233; SHELL_MAX_COMMANDS 232 -> 256 after 232 filled exactly and silently refused the last registration); L1 interfaces 146 -> 162 (klog 6 + watchdog 5 + health 5). Gates, on the release ISO: WP-12 E2E 14/14 across pc/q35/q35+WDAT, regression 28/28, dhtest 5/5, cryptotest, SSH E2E 5/5, HTTPS E2E 7/7, BIOS + UEFI boots, 0 errors 0 warnings. Build 250.
